reason: This report models long-distance transport of CRUDE OIL only. Every unit-process table it contains (Tab. 5.1 onshore pipeline, Tab. 5.2 offshore pipeline, Tab. 5.3/5.4 pipeline construction, Tab. 6.1 produced crude oil transported to refineries) is about crude oil, and the distance tables (Tab. 3.1-3.4) are crude-oil export shares. Nothing in the 16 captions documents the transport of Azerbaijani natural gas to a long-distance pipeline, nor gas losses or seasonal storage emissions, so the inventory of this dataset is not in this report.
